conventions.frame_ids: frame id = id of the canonical annihilator; record "a" lists integer annihilator rows (frame = common kernel), record "b" lists integer basis rows; id 0 (empty "a") is the full space Q^h
conventions.gram: G = I - J/9 on Q^h (H0 = G/2, H0(chi_S,chi_T) = (|S cap T|-1)/2); nondegeneracy tested for G
conventions.nodes: zero-based graph nodes; nodes < v are the source leaves (port index)
conventions.ops: [dest, control, node]: dest ^= control at the frame of node (copies: dest is the fresh role)
conventions.target_covector: 3*chi_T - 1 (target cap = {u : (3 chi_T - 1).u = 0} = H0-orthogonal complement of chi_T)

schedule: old-value reads of non-gauged roles (frame 0); V injections at <chi_S>; ops in order (phase1 ops are those listed); centre copies read at 0; gauged old-value reads at their gauge frames (ascending per target); side root reads in root order; partial-K deliveries right after root deliver_after_root; undo at full frame; inverse ops; V removal
descent: op_frame[i] is the physical frame of ops[i]; each lies between the join of the previous frames and the meet of the next frames of its two roles (#131); own endpoint descent
reuse: late compensated reuse: the recipient slot is the donor register; its old-value read at sigma happens at reads[recipient] (execution order: phase-one ops first), after the last op of the donor
